knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Added Decidable instances, proved 945 smallest odd abundant + semiperfect, proved odd_weird_gt_945. Eliminated 2 axioms (properDivisors_lt, no_weird_below_70). 4A remain (all deep).

945 is semiperfect: remove {3,27} from proper divisors, rest sums to 945
Any odd weird number must exceed 945 (no odd abundant below, 945 semiperfect)
